Set Authentication:Authority (your CIAM authority URL) + Authentication:Audience (the API app's client-id / Application-ID-URI) via env or Key Vault, never here. // Ai: NutritionAssistant (MAF). Provider: None|OpenAI|AzureOpenAI|Ollama. Put the ApiKey in user-secrets or env (Ai__ApiKey / OPENAI_API_KEY), never here. Unconfigured ⇒ the assistant returns 503.
// YouTube: Recipe-import description fetch (OPTIONAL). Set the Data API key in user-secrets/env (YouTube__ApiKey / YOUTUBE_API_KEY) or the Aspire 'youtube-api-key' parameter, never here. Unset ⇒ import falls back to oEmbed (title/thumbnail) + pasted recipe text.
